-- | A <tt>Secret a</tt> newtype whose <a>Show</a> renders a redacted
--   placeholder and whose <a>ToJSON</a>/<a>FromJSON</a>,
--   <a>ToCBOR</a>/<a>FromCBOR</a> and <a>Codec.Serialise.Serialise</a>
--   instances are compile-time errors carrying a custom message (via
--   <a>GHC.TypeError</a>). The instances stay visible to the constraint
--   solver, so a record containing a <a>Secret</a> field can still
--   <tt>deriving stock (Show)</tt> for free while any attempt to serialise
--   it fails to compile. The only accessor is the continuation-style
--   <a>withSecret</a>; there is no <tt>revealSecret</tt>.
@package secret
@version 0.1.0.0


-- | A type-level barrier around values that must never be shown, logged,
--   or serialised.
--   
--   Wrapping a value in <a>Secret</a> makes the following a compile-time
--   error (via <a>TypeError</a>) with a custom message:
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><a>ToJSON</a> / <a>FromJSON</a></li>
--   <li><a>ToCBOR</a> / <a>FromCBOR</a></li>
--   <li><a>Serialise</a></li>
--   </ul>
--   
--   <a>Show</a> is provided but renders as a redacted placeholder
--   (<tt>"&lt;Secret field of type &lt;typename&gt;&gt;"</tt>), so
--   enclosing records can still <tt>deriving stock (Show)</tt> for free.
--   
--   The only way to read the wrapped value is <a>withSecret</a>, a
--   continuation- style accessor: there is intentionally no
--   <tt>revealSecret :: Secret a -&gt; a</tt>. That forces every
--   consumption site to be a small lexical scope and keeps raw values from
--   outliving the use site.
module Data.Secret

-- | A value the type system refuses to show or serialise.
data Secret a
mkSecret :: a -> Secret a

-- | The only escape hatch. Continuation-style so the raw value is never
--   bound at the call site outside the supplied function.
withSecret :: Secret a -> (a -> r) -> r
type Forbid op = TypeError ('Text "Refusing to " ':<>: 'Text op ':<>: 'Text " a value marked as secret." ':$$: 'Text "Secret values (e.g. signing keys) must not be" ':$$: 'Text "shown, logged, or serialised. Use `withSecret` from" ':$$: 'Text "Data.Secret to consume the inner value at its" ':$$: 'Text "point of use (e.g. signing). If you got here from a" ':$$: 'Text "derived `Show` / `ToJSON` on an enclosing record," ':$$: 'Text "either drop that deriving clause or write a" ':$$: 'Text "hand-rolled instance that omits the secret field.")
instance GHC.Classes.Ord a => GHC.Classes.Ord (Data.Secret.Secret a)
instance GHC.Classes.Eq a => GHC.Classes.Eq (Data.Secret.Secret a)
instance Data.Secret.Forbid "encode to JSON" => Data.Aeson.Types.ToJSON.ToJSON (Data.Secret.Secret a)
instance Data.Secret.Forbid "decode from JSON" => Data.Aeson.Types.FromJSON.FromJSON (Data.Secret.Secret a)
instance (Data.Typeable.Internal.Typeable a, Data.Secret.Forbid "CBOR-encode") => Cardano.Binary.ToCBOR.ToCBOR (Data.Secret.Secret a)
instance (Data.Typeable.Internal.Typeable a, Data.Secret.Forbid "CBOR-decode") => Cardano.Binary.FromCBOR.FromCBOR (Data.Secret.Secret a)
instance Data.Secret.Forbid "Serialise-encode" => Codec.Serialise.Class.Serialise (Data.Secret.Secret a)
instance Data.Typeable.Internal.Typeable a => GHC.Show.Show (Data.Secret.Secret a)
